previewDeathNotice.description:
Donnelly (Rush, Co. Dublin) 14th March, 2020 (peacefully) John (Sean), sadly missed by his loving sisters Pauline and Ann, nieces, nephews, great-nieces and nephews, relatives and friends.

May John (Sean) Rest In Peace

Reposing at Fitzgerald's Funeral Home, Rush, tomorrow, from 4pm to 6pm with removal on Wednesday morning to St Maur's Church, Rush, for 10am Mass, followed by buiral in Whitestown Cemetery.

 

Due to the goverment advice and HSE guidelines. Those who would have liked to attend the Funeral, but due to current restrictions cannot, please feel free to leave a message in the Condolence Book at the bottom of this page. Thank you.
